paragraphs: With over seven years in frontend development, I've honed my skills in creating scalable, user-focused web applications. My expertise lies in using React and TypeScript to build intuitive and impactful digital products.

I am a firm believer in quality-first development. I champion Test-Driven Development (TDD), comprehensive automated testing, and creating accessible, high-performing applications. My goal is to deliver code that is not only functional but also robust and inclusive for all users.

My journey is now taking me towards full-stack development and the exciting world of AI. I'm passionate about leveraging data to build intelligent applications and am actively expanding my knowledge in this area.
